counterexampleInterpretation: Control can still produce three visible messages, including two duplicates, when new model call IDs and a new outcome-run replay are injected; treatment preserves one platform status.
After context is acknowledged and a crash occurs before visible delivery, a deliberately silent control model can leave no visible acknowledgement; treatment preserves a durable one.
Arbitrary model-authored paraphrases or incorrect facts are not semantically classified away in either mode. The durable platform status is stronger than a guarantee about all model prose.
